title: BiomedCLIP
paper_title: BiomedCLIP: a multimodal biomedical foundation model pretrained from fifteen million scientific image-text pairs
core_mech: 以 PMC-15M 广域生物医学 figure–caption 语料、ViT 视觉塔和 PubMedBERT 文本塔训练领域 CLIP。
core_mech_en: Domain-specific CLIP trained on PMC-15M (15 million biomedical figure–caption pairs from PubMed Central) using a ViT vision tower and PubMedBERT text tower.
input_desc: 生物医学图像/论文图与对应 caption
input_en: Biomedical image (radiology, pathology, microscopy, chart) + scientific figure caption
output_desc: 开放词汇生物医学图文共享嵌入
output_en: Open-vocabulary biomedical multimodal embeddings for retrieval, zero-shot classification, and VQA

source.title: BiomedCLIP
notes: Only public model-card metadata was inspected. No gated files or pretrained weights were downloaded; code, weights and dataset terms must each be respected.

gaps: The published BiomedCLIP architecture, biomedical tokenizer and pretraining workflow are not supplied by the generic CLIP lesson. No BiomedCLIP weights are bundled.
